+import re
+import sys
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def update_version(version: str):
+    file_path = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    content = file_path.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
+    file_path.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Updated version to {version} in {file_path}")
+
+def add_version_header(version: str):
+    file_path = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    content = file_path.read_text()
+    
+    # Check if the version header already exists
+    if f"## {version}" in content:
+        print(f"Version header {version} already exists in {file_path}")
+        return
+
+    lines = content.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    
+    # Find the first version header (e.g., ## 0.136.3)
+    version_header_pattern = re.compile(r"^## \d+\.\d+\.\d+")
+    
+    insert_index = -1
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if version_header_pattern.match(line):
+            insert_index = i
+            break
+    
+    if insert_index == -1:
+        # If no version header found, append to the end
+        lines.append(f"\n## {version}\n")
+    else:
+        # Insert before the first version header
+        lines.insert(insert_index, f"\n## {version}\n")
+    
+    file_path.write_text("".join(lines))
+    print(f"Added version header {version} to {file_path}")
+
+def add_release_date():
+    print("Adding release date to release notes...")
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], check=True)
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print("Usage: python scripts/release.py <version>")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    version = sys.argv[1]
+    update_version(version)
+    add_version_header(version)
+    add_release_date()
+    print("Release preparation complete!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
